insights.title: Severe Weekday Scheduling Bottleneck
insights.finding: 64% of respondents reported availability exclusively for weekends.
insights.evidence: 311 of 486 responses selected 'Weekend-only'. Only 38 respondents (8%) are available during weekday daytime windows.
insights.interpretation: Key pre-summit preparations, vendor walk-throughs, and staging drills scheduled on Thursdays and Fridays will face critical volunteer staffing shortages.
insights.suggested_action: Recalibrate the orientation and staging schedule to weekend evening shifts, or create dedicated academic excuse credit for weekday operations.

insights.title: Content & PR Track Severely Underrepresented
insights.finding: Only 9% of applicants selected Editorial Content & PR as their primary track.
insights.evidence: 44 of 486 total applications compared to 151 (31%) for Marketing and 136 (28%) for Technical Infrastructure.
insights.interpretation: The editorial team lacks sufficient capacity to cover live sessions, write founder press briefs, and run post-event speaker recap newsletters.
insights.suggested_action: Interview dual-track candidates from Marketing who indicated strong writing and copywriting background.

insights.title: Second-Year Participation Lag
insights.finding: Second-year (Sophomore) students represent only 18% of applicants despite holding key club experience.
insights.evidence: 87 of 486 responses compared to 233 from 1st Year (48%) and 117 from 3rd Year (24%).
insights.interpretation: Mid-tier leadership continuity between graduating 4th years and upcoming juniors may be compromised next cycle.
insights.suggested_action: Target sophomore academic department WhatsApp and Slack channels with a fast-track coordinator application.

insights.title: High Technical Lead Readiness
insights.finding: 42 respondents in the Technical track have extensive prior event tech experience.
insights.evidence: 42 of 136 technical applicants reported prior infrastructure or hackathon management experience.
insights.interpretation: The platform, live stream, ticketing verification, and badge printing operations can be fully staffed with seasoned student engineers.
insights.suggested_action: Advance the top 20 technical candidates directly to the technical lead interview round.

insights.title: Strong Overall Volume & 82% Completion Rate
insights.finding: 486 submissions recorded with an average completion duration of 3 minutes 42 seconds.
insights.evidence: Completion rate reached 82.4% across 590 unique form visits, indicating low question friction.
insights.interpretation: The 9-question structure and clear track grouping are well-calibrated for student respondent attention spans.
insights.suggested_action: Maintain the 9-question format without adding redundant qualification fields.
